title: AMT COBOL Migration HTML Template Content Contract — v1
description: Defines the structure of content data that can be injected into SSG Trial Progress HTML templates.

templateVersion.description: Template version (e.g., 'v1'). Must match the template filename suffix.

trialName.description: Trial identifier (e.g., 'trial-03-payroll'). Used in output filenames and page headers.

generatedAt.description: ISO 8601 datetime when content was generated.

programRows.description: Array of program status rows for SSG-Trial-Progress.html. One row per SSG program.

programId.description: COBOL PROGRAM-ID value (e.g., 'LOADIS-ASCII'). Matches candidate .TXT filename.

ssgElementName.description: SSG element name from manifest (e.g., 'LOADIS_MULT-NODUP'). Visible in Progress HTML.

status.description: Trial status badge: pending (○), in-progress (◑), done (✓), failed (✗).

candidateBytes.description: Size in bytes of generated candidate .TXT file. Used in 'PASS trial-03 NNNNb' badge.

candidateLink.description: Relative or absolute URI to candidate file (e.g., '../EclCobolPipeline/candidates/trial-03-loadis-ascii/LOADIS-ASCII.TXT').

notes.description: Optional notes or issues discovered during trial.

commandMatrixRows.description: Array of command matrix entries for SSG-ECL-Command-Matrix.html. One row per SSG directive.

directiveName.description: SSG directive name (e.g., '*IF', '*SET', '*LOOP'). Shown in first column.

description.description: Plain-text description of the directive's purpose and usage.

programColumns.description: Program-specific cells: keys are programId (e.g., 'LOADIS-ASCII'), values are status/notes.

patternBadges.description: Array of pattern classifications (e.g., 'arithmetic', 'conditional', 'loop'). Updates Section 4 badges.

runbookEntries.description: Array of runbook entries for SSG-ECL-PowerShell-Reference.html. One entry per documented tool/script.

description.description: Concise description of what the tool does.

usageExample.description: Command-line example with parameters. Do NOT include Unicode (PS5.1 limitation).

outputs.description: Description of what the tool produces (e.g., 'HTML file', 'manifest updates').

notes.description: Additional notes or warnings (e.g., 'Requires PS5.1 on Windows', 'Check exit code').
